Porto-Saragozza — Bologna, Italy

🟡 Local-source safety assessment · 6 areas reviewed individually Methodology →

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

The western half of the centre plus Saragozza and the start of the portico up to San Luca: well-off, and the part of the centre most visitors find pleasant. The one documented qualifier is nightlife rather than crime — via del Pratello is the city's densest bar street and generates the noise and drunkenness complaints that come with that. The quartiere's hillside edge is inside the neighbourhood-watch pact the Comune signed with the Comicolli residents' association, which runs to 31 December 2026 and exists because of burglaries of houses on the hills — a resident's problem, not a visitor's.
